'''2004 World Championship Day 3 Nick Jones DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nick Jones]] at [[2004 World Championship]] (Day 3); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Nick "The Quick" Jones (2004-08-24).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=33544 Day 3 One Last Breath]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20070920153408/http://decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=33544 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Nick Jones]]
* '''Event:''' [[2004 World Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
